messages.text: Where is my order? email (email hidden)

Jeremy, there's progress. Your B30 from Shop···· has been packed and labelled today at our Tennessee warehouse, with its Power K. in the same box. Tracking: (tracking link hidden) It may only show movement once the carrier scans it.

The B30 for Shop···· is still waiting for the next units to be checked in there. Its Power K. is already set aside for it. That order has now missed November 15. I'm sorry. Your request from yesterday is still with the team, and they'll confirm its date by email.

You can follow that batch here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
You're welcome, Jeremy. The tracking link will show movement on the first B30 once the carrier scans it. The team will email you the date for the second one.
